data_assets.name: FOCA-rs
data_assets.notes: Open-source mobile OSINT, document metadata & forensics engine (GNU GPL v3.0).

data_assets.name: Inter Font
data_assets.notes: Embedded UI typeface (`ui/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf`, `Inter-SemiBold.ttf`), © Rasmus Andersson.

data_assets.name: Fluent Emoji (App Icon)
data_assets.notes: Application icon artwork, © Microsoft Corporation.

data_assets.name: Natural Earth 1:110m & 1:50m
data_assets.notes: Offline world country boundaries for the 3D GPS globe (`ui/data/ne110.js`, `ne50.js`).

data_assets.name: SecLists (pinned commit 1a89b46)
data_assets.notes: Embedded gzipped path/subdomain discovery wordlists (`crates/foca-fuzz/wordlists`, `crates/foca-net/wordlists`), © Daniel Miessler.

data_assets.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV)
data_assets.notes: Filtered offline snapshot (`crates/foca-analysis/signatures/kev.tsv.gz`, 17 U.S.C. § 105). CISA does not endorse FOCA-rs.

data_assets.name: Cloud & CDN IP Prefix Lists
data_assets.notes: Aggregated public CIDR prefixes (Cloudflare, AWS, Azure, GCP, Fastly, DigitalOcean, Akamai, Hetzner) in `crates/foca-net/data/cloud_ranges.txt.gz`.

data_assets.name: Security Standards Identifiers
data_assets.notes: Rule-to-identifier mapping only (`standards.toml`): MITRE ATT&CK v20, CWE (2025 Top 25 flag), OWASP Top 10:2025 & WSTG v4.2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 / НД ТЗІ 3.6-006-24 control ids and titles, GDPR and Law of Ukraine No. 2297-VI article numbers, НД ТЗІ 2.5-004-99, НД ТЗІ 3.7-003-05.

data_assets.name: FOCA (ElevenPaths / Telefónica Tech)
data_assets.notes: Inspiration for document OSINT & backups fuzzing workflows; clean-room Rust implementation.

data_assets.name: ffuf / gau / waymore / subfinder / go-dork / ds_store / Wappalyzer
data_assets.notes: Algorithmic concepts (soft-404 auto-calibration, CDX pagination, passive subdomain endpoints, DS_Store & tech fingerprinting); clean-room Rust code.

data_assets.name: MurmurHash3
data_assets.notes: Clean-room Rust implementation of MurmurHash3 x86_32 for Shodan/FOFA favicon hashing.

data_assets.name: can-i-take-over-xyz (pinned 5bd4e1283791)
data_assets.notes: Subdomain takeover fingerprints from can-i-take-over-xyz by EdOverflow and contributors (CC BY 4.0); fields reduced and renamed by FOCA-rs, https://github.com/EdOverflow/can-i-take-over-xyz. Signature data in `crates/foca-net/data/takeover.json`.

data_assets.name: endoflife (pinned 32423d8113b6)
data_assets.notes: End-of-life dates from endoflife.date, Copyright 2020 endoflife.date contributors, MIT License, https://endoflife.date. Signature data in `crates/foca-recon/data/endoflife.tsv.gz`.

data_assets.name: epss (pinned 2026-11-26)
data_assets.notes: EPSS scores from FIRST.org (https://www.first.org/epss), 2026-11-26. Signature data in `crates/foca-analysis/signatures/kev_enrich.tsv.gz`.

data_assets.name: gitleaks (pinned v8.30.1)
data_assets.notes: Secret detection rules from gitleaks, Copyright (c) 2019 Zachary Rice, MIT License, https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks. Signature data in `crates/foca-analysis/signatures/secrets_gitleaks.toml`.

data_assets.name: nvd (pinned 2026-11-27)
data_assets.notes: This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD. CVE data from the NIST National Vulnerability Database (public domain), https://nvd.nist.gov. Signature data in `crates/foca-analysis/signatures/nvd_cve.tsv.gz`.

data_assets.name: psl (pinned 88b076a1fb2a)
data_assets.notes: Public Suffix List, Mozilla Foundation and contributors, MPL-2.0, https://publicsuffix.org (shipped unmodified). Signature data in `crates/foca-net/data/public_suffix_list.dat.gz`.

data_assets.name: recog (pinned f1191e24332c)
data_assets.notes: Service and favicon fingerprints from Recog, Copyright (c) 2014-2015, Rapid7, BSD 2-Clause License, https://github.com/rapid7/recog. Signature data in `crates/foca-net/data/recog.tsv.gz`, `crates/foca-recon/data/favicons_md5.tsv`.

data_assets.name: retire (pinned da66c52a5a5a)
data_assets.notes: JavaScript library vulnerability data from Retire.js, Copyright 2018 Erlend Oftedal, Apache License 2.0, https://github.com/RetireJS/retire.js. Signature data in `crates/foca-recon/data/retire.json.gz`.

data_assets.name: vulnrichment (pinned 2872f0a7d9f8)
data_assets.notes: CVSS, CWE and SSVC data from CISA Vulnrichment (CC0-1.0), https://github.com/cisagov/vulnrichment. Signature data in `crates/foca-analysis/signatures/kev_enrich.tsv.gz`.
